# Vendor Landscape

The identity market is split into a few distinct categories, and each category solves a different slice of the problem this site covers: [IAM fundamentals](/docs/fundamentals/what-is-iam), [protocols](/docs/protocols-iga/ldap), and [PAM](/docs/pam-core/what-is-pam).

- **PAM specialists**: CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust. Vaulting, session management, and endpoint privilege control as their core products.
- **The Microsoft stack**: on-prem Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, and MIM. The default identity platform for most enterprises, partly because the directory was there first.
- **Cloud IAM**: the native identity services of AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. Each hyperscaler ships its own policy model, and understanding the differences is a core skill.
- **Governance tools**: SailPoint, Okta Identity Governance, Saviynt. Certification campaigns, role management, and segregation of duties.

## Suggestion order

Start with [The vendor landscape](01-major-vendors.md), then read the two or three pages closest to your interest. If you are preparing for interviews, read all of them: the comparison page ([comparison and evaluation](08-vendor-comparison.md)) is where the interview questions about "which tool when" are answered.

## Fact-checking note

Vendor product names, certification names and eligibility, and corporate relationships change. Every claim on these pages was verified against vendor sources on 2026-08-18; each page carries a verification date comment at the top, and certification prices should be confirmed at purchase time.
